_note: The default one-pager. Copy this file to <company>.json and tune `summary`, the chosen bullet ids, and any `text` overrides for a specific job description. Every bullet id must exist in content/career.json — the renderer fails on unknown ids, which is what stops invented claims. This base variant is DOMAIN-NEUTRAL: healthcare standards are trimmed to one item. For a healthcare role, copy it and add the 'domain' skills group and the FHIR/OMOP highlights back.
summary: Senior software engineer, five years on distributed backends where correctness is not optional - service integration, event-driven architecture, cloud infrastructure, access control and applied ML. Owns systems from design to the CI/CD that ships them, and mentors the engineers who build on them.

bullets.text: Built the integration hub's base adapter modules, turning each new integration from a bespoke build into a pattern
Designed and shipped a full RBAC system: admin-only endpoints, per-role response filtering, pre-auth checks
Mapped business entitlements onto Microsoft Entra, enforcing endpoint and data-level access via JWT claims
Remediated static-analysis security findings and led a security overhaul separating study-team and participant concerns
Introduced server-sent events for real-time feedback across the platform
Cut the backend deploy pipeline from 26m33s to 18m07s (-32%)
Eliminated $200+/month (~$2.4k/yr) of idle cloud spend by decommissioning legacy services
Modelled clinical protocols and surveys on FHIR resources with OMOP/LOINC terminology; change logs via FHIR provenance
Drove requirements with the client, turning whiteboard sessions into wireframes and an E2E implementation
Cut the deployable image from 19 GB to 5.28 GB (-72%) through packaging design
Designed the codebase so the third-party model ships with the system and its licence swaps on expiry without a rebuild
Wrote the Node backend from scratch, driving the C++ binaries over Redis so the whole system shared one source of truth
Cut pipeline latency from 22s to 2s by moving reconstruction in-memory and eliminating a per-frame signed distance field
Onboarded two junior engineers and led the project through a stretch when tech leads were unavailable
